description: This file defines configuration-related code for a backend system, including environment variable parsing, a Settings dataclass for application configuration, and a helper function to parse database connection strings. It is used to set up environment-specific settings and provide centralized configuration access throughout the application.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A frozen dataclass encapsulating the application's configuration parameters such as database DSN, JWT settings, CORS origins, and admin credentials. Includes a static method to instantiate the class from environment variables.

methods.name: Settings.from_env
methods.description: Static method that reads environment variables and, if necessary, the database connection string from a file, to return an instance of Settings populated with the configuration parameters.
